issues.description: The solution SQL for Aufgabe 09 uses a numeric literal in the WHERE clause (Gemeinde.name = 12345) even though the problem asks for zoos in a municipality named "Erlangen". This contradicts the problem statement (string comparison) and treats the Gemeinde.name attribute as a number, which is a type/values mismatch and will produce incorrect results or errors.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution file aufgabe09.sql, replace the numeric comparison with the string literal for the municipality name. For example: WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen'. Ensure the municipality name is quoted as a string.
